entries.name: Lula Mae White

expected.charges: Freedom Ride participation — traveled from Montgomery, refused to comply with terminal segregation, arrested at the Jackson Trailways terminal, July 9, 1961.
expected.convicted: Unresolved — the arrest is documented; the disposition is not established in the CRDL record
expected.sentence: Arrested 1961-07-09. The Civil Rights Digital Library establishes the arrest and the identification photograph but not the disposition, any transfer to Parchman, or the release date — unresolved pending court, jail, or penitentiary records.

updates.sentence: Sentenced to four months following the July 9, 1961 Freedom Ride arrest. The New Haven Register reports that she actually served one month. Her exact release date remains unverified.

entries.rationale: The newspaper distinguishes the four-month sentence from one month actually served. Add the documented month total without constructing a release date. Preserve all biography fields.
